messages.subject: 📅 Save the Date: 2026 Immcantation Users Group Meeting – January 22, 2026
messages.subject_clean: 📅 Save the Date: 2026 Immcantation Users Group Meeting – January 22, 2026
messages.body_plain:
Dear Immcantation Community,

We’re excited to announce that the 2026 Immcantation Users Group Meeting will take place on January 22nd, 2026 — and we hope you'll join us!

This annual event brings together researchers, developers, and users to share insights, learn about recent developments, and connect around all things Immcantation and Adaptive Immune Receptor Repertoire (AIRR) analysis.

📅 Date: January 22nd, 2026 (from 10:00am to 1:30pm ET)
📍 Location: Virtual (Zoom)
🗓️ Important dates: To be announced shortly

Stay tuned! Visit https://immcantation.github.io/users-meeting/2026 for updated information, including registration, agenda, and abstract submission deadlines.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Warm regards,
The Immcantation Team
https://immcantation.org
